Package org.ddolib.nolayer.modeling

package org.ddolib.nolayer.modeling
This package contains the interfaces and abstract classes that must be implemented as problem specific classes to model a problem with the no-layer API (no fixed number of variables, termination detected via Problem.isTarget(Object)). It also contains default implementations and the per-algorithm *Model bundles (DdoModel, AcsModel, AwAstarModel) as well as the Solvers facade used to run any of them.
  • Class
    Description
    AcsModel<T>
    Defines the structure of an optimization model solved using the Anytime Column Search (ACS) algorithm within the Decision Diagram Optimization (DDO) framework using the NoLayer API.
    AwAstarModel<T>
     
    DdoModel<T>
    Defines the interface for an unlayered Dynamic Decision Diagram Optimization (DDO) model.
    DefaultFastLowerBound<T>
    Default implementation of FastLowerBound that always returns 0.0.
    DefaultNoLayerDominanceChecker<T>
     
    FastLowerBound<T>
    Interface defining a lower bounding function for a state.
    Model<T>
    Defines the core model interface for describing an optimization problem in the NoLayer API.
    NoLayerDominanceChecker<T>
    Defines a dominance checking mechanism to prune search states in NoLayer models.
    Problem<T>
    Represents an optimization problem formulated as a labeled transition system, without requiring an a priori fixed number of variables.
    Relaxation<T>
    Defines the relaxation rules for merging states in unlayered decision diagrams.
    Solvers
    The Solvers class acts as a unified entry point for running different optimization algorithms within the no-layer Decision Diagram Optimization (DDO) framework.
